item.title: A message from the main office:
item.description: Today is Orange Shirt Day. The orange shirt has become a symbol of hope, reconciliation, and commitment to a better future. By wearing an orange shirt on September 30th, you make a statement to support truth & reconciliation and commit to the enduring truth that “EVERY CHILD MATTERS”. Inspired by Phyllis Webstad’s story of having her orange shirt taken away on her first day at Indian residential school, we uplift the voices of Survivors and invite all people in Canada to walk the path of truth & reconciliation together.

item.title: A message from Mrs. Longval:
item.description: Interested in joining open weight room training sessions at lunch or after school? All STA students in Grades 9–12 are welcome! Before attending open weight room sessions, there are two things to do. Step 1 : Grab a consent form. Forms are available outside Mrs. Longval’s office. Please read and complete the form, have a parent or guardian sign it if you’re under 18, and return it to Mrs. Longval. Step 2: Sign up for a safety orientation. Sign-up sheets with dates and session times are on the bulletin board outside Mrs. Longval’s office. Choose a session and add your name! These 15-minute sessions cover weight room procedures and safety precautions so students are ready to participate. Maximum 15 students per session. No need to get changed into your PE uniform! Just come to the weight room at your chosen time. If you are currently taking, or have previously taken, Personal Fitness with Mrs. Longval, you do not need to attend an orientation session but you still need to complete and return the consent form. Please see Mrs. Longval if you have any questions!
